tagline: Peyek Den Bagus: fish-based rempeyek from Setu that has moved into modern retail and airport gift channels.

story.title: Peyek Den Bagus: fish-based rempeyek from Setu that has moved into modern retail and airport gift channels.
story.body: Peyek Den Bagus is owned by Mimin Casmiaty in Setu. Tangsel Pos reported the business started in 2022 and now produces fish-based rempeyek variants such as anchovy and shrimp, with tuna-nori variants in development. The products have reached retail, gift stores and Soekarno-Hatta Terminal 2, while the Peyek Den Bagus mark is also recorded in the Indonesian trademark gazette.
